test_0074_e_commerce:answered_wrong.label: real_error

test_0129_bbc_channels:answered_wrong.label: ambiguous

test_0296_customers_and_orders:answered_.label: real_error

test_0432_vehicle_rent:answered_wrong.label: real_error

test_0456_cre_Students_Information_Syste.label: ambiguous

test_0464_cre_Students_Information_Syste.label: benchmark_fault

test_0504_cre_Students_Information_Syste.label: benchmark_fault
test_0504_cre_Students_Information_Syste.reason: The question says “for each student,” implying inclusion of students with zero courses; the gold uses an inner join that omits them, while the system’s LEFT JOIN with COUNT(class_id) correctly includes zero-count students.

test_0655_club_leader:answered_wrong.label: benchmark_fault

test_0711_cre_Doc_and_collections:answer.label: real_error

test_0819_address_1:answered_wrong.label: real_error

test_0820_address_1:answered_wrong.label: ambiguous
test_0820_address_1:answered_wrong.reason: The question does not specify whether to return city pairs or unique city codes; the system reasonably returns the set of city codes participating in any above‑average distance, while the gold returns pairs.

test_0939_headphone_store:answered_wrong.reason: The system returns earpad types that appear on some non-plastic models but may also appear with plastic, whereas “never use plastic” requires excluding any earpads that appear with plastic at all (as the gold EXCEPT logic does).

test_1006_aan_1:answered_wrong.label: ambiguous

test_1059_conference:answered_wrong.label: real_error

test_1073_conference:answered_wrong.label: ambiguous

test_1153_pilot_1:answered_wrong.label: real_error

test_1178_pilot_1:answered_wrong.label: benchmark_fault

test_1291_art_1:answered_wrong.label: benchmark_fault
test_1291_art_1:answered_wrong.reason: The system correctly computes per-painter averages and orders by painter name, while the gold query orders by painting title and returns painterID, which contradicts the prompt and is likely invalid grouping/order logic.

test_1305_art_1:answered_wrong.label: benchmark_fault
test_1305_art_1:answered_wrong.reason: The question asks for the artist(s) with the maximum number of oil paintings, but the gold query returns the top 3; the system’s single top artist matches the question’s intent.

test_1401_real_estate_rentals:answered_w.label: benchmark_fault
test_1401_real_estate_rentals:answered_w.reason: The question asks for the state/province for each property (one row per property), but the gold query uses DISTINCT to return a unique set; the system’s non-DISTINCT join matches the question’s intent.

test_1556_bakery_1:answered_wrong.label: ambiguous
test_1556_bakery_1:answered_wrong.reason: The question could mean either the price of the cheapest cheese-flavored good or which good is cheapest; the system reasonably returned the item id while the gold returns the price.

test_1718_warehouse_1:answered_wrong.label: real_error
test_1718_warehouse_1:answered_wrong.reason: The system filters for a single box whose Contents include both 'Rocks' and 'Scissors', whereas the question (and gold) require warehouses that have boxes with Rocks and boxes with Scissors, yielding a different and incorrect result.

test_1773_university_rank:answered_wrong.label: real_error
test_1773_university_rank:answered_wrong.reason: It wrongly filters out universities with enrollment <= 2000 before averaging, whereas the question requires averaging all universities per conference and then applying HAVING avg(enrollment) > 2000, leading to an extra, incorrect conference.

test_1842_movie_2:answered_wrong.label: real_error
test_1842_movie_2:answered_wrong.reason: The system’s inner join to Movies excluded theaters that have entries in MovieTheaters (i.e., at least one showing), while the question only asks for distinct theater names with any movie playing, which the gold query correctly returns.

test_2008_book_press:answered_wrong.label: benchmark_fault
test_2008_book_press:answered_wrong.reason: The question says “for each press,” implying all presses including zero-counts; the system’s LEFT JOIN counts zeros correctly, while the gold query’s INNER JOIN excludes presses without qualifying books.

test_2066_advertising_agencies:answered_.reason: “Each agency” can reasonably include agencies with zero clients; the system’s LEFT JOIN returns those with 0 while the gold counts only agencies that have clients.
